channel.description: Latest articles from Car and Driver (caranddriver.com)

item.title: Toyota Tacoma TRD Off-Road 6MT Test: The Omega Man(ual)
item.description: The Tacoma is the last manual-transmission pickup left on the market. Will it find enough die-hards to keep it alive?

item.title: The Stunning Lexus LC Will Finally Be Laid to Rest Later This Year
item.description: While the writing was on the wall, we now know that Lexus's gorgeous grand tourer will end production this August.

item.title: VW Exec Says the Sportiest Golfs Will Live on with Revamped Engines
item.description: An executive reportedly said VW is working to make the EA888 2.0-liter engine compliant with emissions regulations beyond 2030.

item.title: BMW's Iconic Logo Is Changing, but You Probably Won't Even Notice
item.description: The new BMW roundel debuted on the iX3 EV SUV, and it'll be introduced on other models starting next month.

item.title: Bending the Rules: 2000 Honda S2000 vs. the German Roadsters
item.description: Honda's new bargain-priced bullet forces us into an unconventional comparison of sports-car values. Hey, what are rules for?

item.title: View Photos of the 2000 Honda S2000 vs. The German Roadsters
item.description: See exterior and interior photos of the 2000 Honda S2000, 1999 BMW M roadster, Mercedes-Benz SLK, and Porsche Boxster from every angle.

item.title: This Lifted Bentley Bentayga Could Preview a Production Model
item.description: The concept was developed to "stimulate feedback" to give the brand insight into a possible off-road model in the future.

item.title: 1972 Saab Sonett on Bring a Trailer: When a Regular Saab Isn't Weird Enough
item.description: Forgive us if we wax poetic about this oddity, among the last of a fondly remembered breed.

item.title: Hyundai Palisade vs. Kia Telluride: Comparing Korea's Mid-Size Three-Row SUVs
item.description: The Hyundai Palisade was redesigned last year, while the second-generation Kia Telluride has just made its debut. Here's how they stack up in terms of size, passenger space, luggage capacity, powertrains, and pricing.

item.title: You Should Road-Trip to the Super Bowl, Like I Did
item.description: Need an excuse for an epic road trip? Each February, there's no greater destination than the biggest sporting event of the year and the circus that surrounds it.
